Messages.Author: Stubby
Messages.Body:
is this card permanet ie. put on vamp. it can never equip that game or
does it burn what ever is there at the time.?

Seven miseries: is this card stackable? and what happens when a vote
is called and the vamp can't play any stealth and there are two
7miseries out ie -2 stealth.

ian.

Messages.Author: James C
Messages.Body:
In article <37ff7a1a...@nntp.netcom.net.uk>,

stu...@netcomuk.co.uk (Stubby) wrote:
> is this card permanet ie. put on vamp. it can never equip that game or
> does it burn what ever is there at the time.?
>

Anachronism
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master. Put this card on a vampire with capacity above 6. Any ranged
weapons possessed by this vampire, except the Ivory Bow, are burned.

The vampire with it burns all weaposn they have now. They are not
prevented from equipping with more, but whenever they do, they are
immediately burned by Anachronism's permanent effect. (Except the Bow,
of course.)

> Seven miseries: is this card stackable? and what happens when a vote
> is called and the vamp can't play any stealth and there are two
> 7miseries out ie -2 stealth.

Yes, its' stackable. Two out give =2 stealth, so +1 (from the vote
card), -2 (from the two miseries) gives an overall initial stealth of -
1.
